root_text:
Human metapneumovirus #HMPV can cause upper & lower respiratory disease in people of all ages, especially among young children, older adults & people with weakened immune systems

Discovered in 2001, HMPV is in the Pneumoviridae fam

nodes.text:
Human metapneumovirus #HMPV can cause upper & lower respiratory disease in people of all ages, especially among young children, older adults & people with weakened immune systems

Discovered in 2001, HMPV is in the Pneumoviridae family along with respiratory syncytial virus

nodes.author: Satyayadav__
nodes.text:
1/2 

It’s not a new virus ! 

There is an outbreak going on in China right now thus global attention 

No one wants to take it easy anything after COVID19 pandemic which started from China 

Prevention -hand washing and avoiding coming in contact with people with cough & cold

nodes.author: Satyayadav__
nodes.text:
1/3 

If you get HMPV infection - there is no treatment available but most people recover on their own 

Supportive care with fever and cough/cold medicines is recommended
